g.text: Exact delayed flow retains growing history; Erlang-4 changes the delay law
One seeded synthetic prefix, B=1, dt=0.05, no optimizer. Same-weight/input support is seed + source provenance; raw values were not saved.
Erlang-4 has mean delay 0.2 and variance 0.01. Deviations use the full exact-flow observable as denominator; no accuracy gate was invented.
Timing includes conservation reads in forward; single timings do not establish a speedup. Saved payload with repeats is not peak allocation.
